notes: Grouped (directory OEIS/A166273). For m = 12n+7 = 6q+1 split 1..m-1 into six blocks of q and residues mod 6 (36 sums); reflection n -> m-n, doubling and tripling (mod m) give 66 linear relations with coefficients chi(2) (= +-1 by m mod 8) and chi(3) = -1, which imply H(1/3) = 2H(1/6), H(1/2) = H(1/6) (m = 7 mod 24) and H(1/2) = -3H(1/6), H(1/3) = -2H(1/6) (m = 19 mod 24), for every m (no primitivity). Mathlib Lean with jacobiSym: A166268_main. Outside Lean: none beyond reading the definitions.

prior_art.note: For prime m the identities follow from classical class-number formulas for partial sums of odd real characters (Berndt 1976, Johnson-Mitchell 1977, Hudson-Williams 1982; exact /6 formula not read here). Composite and non-squarefree m covered by the elementary route here.
